etymologies.etymologyHTML: Borrowed from Latin paenīnsula, from paene (“almost”), and īnsula (“island”).

definitions.definition: (geography) A piece of land projecting into water from a larger land mass.

quote.citation: 1994 November 13, Mike Scully, “Lisa on Ice”, in The Simpsons, season 6, episode 8, production code 6F18:
quote.text: Man cancelling Lisa's inauguration as president: I sentence you to a lifetime of horror on Monster Island. Don't worry, it's just a name.[Lisa and others are chased by fire-breathing monsters]Lisa: He said it was just a name! Man being chased by monsters: What he meant is that Monster Island is actually a peninsula.
